description: Stage-2b: attempt to escape the SIM-036 chi=3 product-state collapse (ERRATA D5) using CHEAP levers only -- an init-scale sweep (random*{0.3,0.6,1.0} x 2 seeds) plus a one-round entanglement-warmup objective (loss = <H> - 0.5*S_half, then anneal to pure energy). Gate enforces energy AND entanglement AND overlap. Did NOT attempt a true DMRG/MPS seed (that is the next step).

results.note_on_completeness: Run was killed at ~4h50m after the best-so-far checkpoint stalled for >2h (trial 1 finished ~11:38, no improvement by 13:51). The remaining trials were not allowed to finish because the best completed trial already reproduced the SIM-036 near-product collapse (S_half 0.0001 ~= SIM-036's 0.0002) -- the cheap levers demonstrably do not escape the basin, so further trials would only re-confirm it at multi-hour cost. The full 6-trial JSON the script would have written was therefore authored by hand from the evaluated checkpoint.
results.verdict: CHEAP seeding (init-scale sweep + soft one-round entanglement penalty) does NOT escape the chi=3 product-state collapse. Best trial: S_half 0.0001 vs exact 0.1795 (0.07% of the true entanglement), essentially identical to SIM-036's collapsed minimum. This is the fallback ERRATA D5 explicitly anticipated. Conclusion: a TRUE DMRG/MPS seed is required -- initialize the MERA isometries/disentanglers from the chi<=6 MPS ground state (cheap to obtain at N=16) rather than from random*scale. Do NOT escalate to chi>=4 yet: chi=3 has the capacity (99.99% of the exact TCI GS per ERRATA D5); the obstruction is purely the optimizer landscape, and a structured seed is the correct tool, not more bond dimension.

notes: Attacks initialization/landscape (the real SIM-036 failure), not bond dimension. Negative but decisive: rules out the cheap shortcut, narrows HYP-027 to the true-MPS-seed path. Likely cause of failure: half_S gradient ~= 0 AT the product state, so a soft penalty cannot push the optimizer uphill out of the basin it already sits in; one warmup round at lambda=0.5 is too weak before the 4 energy rounds pull it back to product. quimb-based DMRG seed is the next instrument.
